title: The Pedrógão Grande fires
summary: A fire that began on the afternoon of 17 June 2017 near Pedrógão Grande killed 66 people, most of them caught in their cars on the roads out, and burned for a week. The Independent Technical Commission appointed by parliament found failures in the alert, in the closing of the roads and in the emergency communications network, and its report is the document everything written since argues with.
